blocks.content: Quiz: What is the purpose of a selector function in Zustand?
Tap an option below to answer:
It filters entries in the database
A selector does not touch a database. It picks state from the store.
A selector does not touch a database. It picks state from the store.
It picks a specific piece of state from the store and can compute derived values from it
Correct! A selector tells Zustand which piece of state a component needs. It can also compute derived values like filtered entries.
Correct! A selector tells Zustand which piece of state a component needs. It can also compute derived values like filtered entries.
It replaces the need for actions
Selectors and actions do different things. Selectors read state. Actions update it.
Selectors and actions do different things. Selectors read state. Actions update it.
Zustand does not connect stores with selectors. A selector just reads from one store.
Zustand does not connect stores with selectors. A selector just reads from one store.
